description: Use this when you need to know what a production finding means, or what production actually requires of an AI-built application. The provider-neutral requirements an application is scanned against, each joined to the TrustyCap capability that is its reference implementation. Use it to understand a finding id such as TC-PROD-0041 from `npx @trustycap/cli productionize`, to see which properties a requirement demands, which other implementations satisfy it, and the exact commands that remediate and verify it. Pass a requirement id to read one, or nothing to read all. No credential needed.

requirement.description: A requirement id, e.g. TC-PROD-0041. Omit for the whole standard.

name: trustycap_production_standard
title: The production readiness standard
